precise_scope: Finite decision type X with pseudometric and true Lipschitz objective. Safe seed is nonempty and genuinely satisfies the threshold at its true objective value.

The constructed endpoints are proved exactly equal to the literal protected source confidence sets C_(n+1), including the seed halfline initialization, and are contained in the actual current raw band.
Raw truth plus seed safety derive valid contained confidence endpoints and their monotonicity, and derive the actual first seed floor.
The persistent-certificate induction derives monotone actual source safe rounds without requiring newly certified decisions to have their own lower endpoint above threshold.
The finite run is constructed from the protected actualRounds at source round n+1. Its literal source safe update, nonemptiness, seed retention and nested finite sets are derived internally.

The finite bound is constructed as the exact actual zero-reachable closure R_0(seed). Its finite membership and cardinality equality with Set.ncard are proved; all actual safe rounds are proved contained in it using the unchanged protected reachability theorem.

True Lipschitz safety and valid lower confidence prove every actual safe-set point safe. The actual width maximizer over the source G/M acquisition union is constructed and its true query value is safe at every query index.

The final theorem composes the previously proved arbitrary normalized finite PSD-kernel posterior/Gamma budget with the initialized actual source run, using the actual zero-reachable ncard in its integer window denominator.

It constructs an attained epsilon-reachable true optimum and gives the epsilon bound for every later actual source lower-band report. No arbitrary containing Finset, supplied monotone safe run, initial floor, contained-confidence validity, source update or nonempty-safe-run premise is needed in this final theorem.
